context.sells: Homeware and small electricals, shipped across the United Kingdom
policyInWords: Returns and claims are accepted for 30 days after delivery; after that the claim is refused with a reason.
A parcel is only treated as lost once 10 days have passed since the last courier scan.
Refunds above 300 are signed off by a person, whatever the merits.
A damage claim needs a photograph before anything is refunded.
A customer who keeps a faulty item is offered 50% back, or 25% for marks that do not affect use.
A third not-received claim from the same customer is refused when the courier has proof of delivery.
Where the shop or its courier is at fault, the shipping charge goes back too.
context.note: Nothing here is acted on. The demo turns a dispute into the call a backend would receive, and stops.
